scenes.text: Twelve hours. No break. And the next patient is already waiting.
I don't have time to look after myself.
You have two minutes. Serein makes room for you.
Three easy breaths, before anything else. Breathe in. And let it go.
Press start my pause, and the Breathing Tide guides you. Breathe in, only as far as feels comfortable.
Breathe out. Let the breath leave, without forcing it.
When you have a little longer, the library has fifteen short practices. Breathing, grounding, gentle movement, from one minute to five.
No streak to keep. Nothing is scored. Nothing is monitored.
Two minutes. I feel human again.
Make room for you. Try it free today, at Serein dot Healthcare Crown Academy dot co dot uk.
